areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Bike lanes, tree-lined spaces and rain gardens encourage sustainable transport and mitigate environmental impacts.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Smart energy-grid technologies and renewable sources reduce greenhouse-gas emissions.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Smart waste management, selective collection and recycling reduce pollution and landfill volume.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Soil and spring conservation and integrated water management help prevent disasters and regulate water flows.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Biodiversity benefit from urban adaptation works is indirect, not the focus of the project.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Investment and work opportunities from public-space upgrading are indirect benefits.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Commercial spaces for small firms are an indirect benefit, not the focus.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Kiosks and fairs for individual entrepreneurs are an indirect benefit.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Expanded everyday facilities are an indirect benefit, not the focus.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Actions benefiting low-income people are an indirect benefit.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: Integrated approach to historical inequalities is an indirect benefit.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Urban education actions for engagement are an indirect benefit.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Health gains from active mobility are indirect.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Renewable-energy measures are not innovative or modern enough for this criterion.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: Private housing production is indirect, not direct private capital as in a PPP-type arrangement.
